GAPS.rationale: Threat coverage matrix (§11.12.9.24) covers 22 topics but has no dedicated TIME_SYNC/CLOCK_SKEW acceptance criterion for exchange request signing/timestamp validity.
GAPS.affected_surface: src/exchange/** request signing; venue timestamp tolerances; operator host clock
GAPS.closure_condition: Documented skew bounds + negative tests for rejected/expired timestamps + evidence seal
GAPS.required_proof: Focused unit/contract tests + sealed package under separate Owner-GO (may fold into STATIC_SECURITY_ANALYSIS or PENETRATION_PROGRAM)

GAPS.rationale: starlette HIGH vulns are in OPTIONAL_WEB_EXTRA scope, yet starlette==0.50.0 is installed in the canonical uv Python 3.11 environment used for audit. No §18.2 criterion proves optional web extras are unreachable / disabled by default in productive Cap-11 paths.
GAPS.affected_surface: pyproject optional web/fastapi; installed starlette in uv env; any webui/ASGI entrypoints
GAPS.closure_condition: Either remove/unreachable optional web stack from default install OR upgrade starlette to fix versions and prove Cap-11 default path does not serve ASGI
GAPS.required_proof: Install graph evidence + negative test that default Cap-11 entrypoints do not import/serve vulnerable web stack OR patched versions + re-audit

GAPS.rationale: Threat model residual explicitly cites local filesystem tampering on operator host outside repo; no dedicated Pre-Live host/runtime permissions criterion exists in §18.2.
GAPS.affected_surface: operator host FS; process env inheritance; state files; KillSwitch state paths
GAPS.closure_condition: Reviewed permissions/ownership assumptions + fail-closed behavior on untrusted state paths with evidence
GAPS.required_proof: Architecture/host review package or extension of RECOVERY_SECURITY_TEST/LIVE_ARMING packages

GAPS.rationale: pip-audit exists in scripts/ops and audit.yml, but required_status_checks.json does not enforce pip-audit as a merge-blocking required context; Dependabot alerts disabled. Continuous fail-closed vuln gating is not a §18.2 criterion.
GAPS.proposed_acceptance_criterion: DEPENDENCY_VULN_CI_FAIL_CLOSED_PROVEN=true OR explicit Owner N/A with compensating control
GAPS.closure_condition: Required-check or equivalent sealed compensating control preventing HIGH CVE merges without Owner exception
GAPS.required_proof: CI contract test + required context binding evidence

GAPS.rationale: uv.lock contains multiple versions per package (pyarrow 20/22, starlette 0.49.3/0.50.0, etc.) under Python markers; human reading of requirements.txt alone can mis-state installed vulnerability posture. Audit correctly used installed env, but no acceptance criterion requires documenting the audited runtime interpreter binding.
GAPS.closure_condition: Every DEPENDENCY_AUDIT package records interpreter version + resolved install set hash
GAPS.required_proof: Already partially present in §11.12.9.26 tooling proofs; elevate to mandatory criterion text
